notes: Web3 phase 2, W1 read-only pilot: the product now ships a built-in, read-only exchange layer. Eight venues in one catalog - OKX and Kraken (public market data needs no key; account reads are slot-gated) plus six keyless on-chain/DEX sources (Jupiter, Velora, Hyperliquid, dYdX Indexer, GMX and public JSON-RPC chain heads) that require no credential at all. Three new READ-ONLY tools: exchange_markets (always registered, keyless), exchange_portfolio and exchange_orders (registered only when at least one CEX credential slot is set; otherwise withheld with an honest exchange_note naming the missing slots). OKX signs Base64(HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp+method+path+body)); Kraken signs Base64(HMAC-SHA512(path+SHA256(nonce+postdata), base64 secret)) and is verified against Kraken's own published example vector. No order placement exists anywhere in this car: prepare/execute separation is a code boundary for W2, auto-execution thresholds default to 0 (fail-closed to full manual approval), and withdrawals and on-chain transfers are never automatic at any threshold. The console gains an Exchange view: eight venue rows with the exact reason a credential slot is unconfigured, the registered tool names, the four-part disclosure (the product is permanently free but trading fees and gas are not zero / not investment advice / risk borne by the user / credentials stay on this machine) and a market probe (GET /api/exchange/quote, public data only, 10 requests per minute). Two new skill packs (okx-read-only, kraken-read-only) and docs/features/exchanges.md document the protocol contracts and honest boundaries. Suites after this car: core 1087/1087, console smoke 158/158, router 30/30, memory 58/58, setup 99/99, profile isolation 63/63, desktop shell 15/15, source lint 0 issues over 65 files, doctor 0F/0W, publish gate READY(0), console screenshot gate 7/7 js-clean, site gate ALL PASS (43 assertions); real-machine E2E: 18/18, 8/8, 44/44, 35/35, web3 read-only 33/33.
